overview: The MPS Building & Grounds Subcommittee met to review district facility projects, voting to prioritize the replacement of the Medford High School generator and to explore costs for front entrance aesthetic and accessibility improvements.

items.title: Medford High School Generator Replacement
items.summary: The subcommittee voted to designate replacing the failed Medford High School generator as a high-priority item for discussion at the upcoming capital improvement plan meeting.

items.title: Medford High School Front Entrance and Accessibility
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a motion directing administration to explore cost estimates for front entrance enhancements, including ADA ramp compliance, new signage, and a potential building banner.

items.title: Solar Speed Signs Installation Update
items.summary: McLaughlin reported that solar speed signs have been delivered and will be installed by the DPW near Medford High School and between the McGlynn and Andrews schools once ground conditions permit.

items.title: Security Systems and Camera Upgrades
items.summary: Murphy reported on planned upgrades to district locks, alarms, and cameras, recommending that specific security details be discussed in executive session before issuing requests for proposals.
